body: Special City Council Meeting - Strategic Planning
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL

UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF ASSEMBLY BILL 361,
WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL
LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO:
publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING: (669) 444-9171 OR USING THE ZOOM
APP WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7760661113; MEETING ID: 776 066 1113.

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 8:00 a.m. on March 26, 2023 in U.S. Constitution Room #4, Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk
Boulevard and via videoconference. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

(Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the item listed. Please fill out a speaker card and turn it in to the
Sergeant at Arms before the meeting commences.)

CALL TO ORDER  Mayor Valencia

ROLL CALL  Assistant City Clerk

REPORT

ESTABLISHING/DISCUSSING GOALS AND PRIORITIES AND IMPLEMENTATION OF UPDATED STRATEGIC
ACTION PLAN.

Dated this 24th day of March 2023.

I, Camille Moreno, Assistant City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall not less
than 24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council and to the following
newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on the 24th day of March
2023.

Assistant City Clerk

  Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it has been
  posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

  Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council on any matter listed on the agenda.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
